new file .changeset/capability-canonical-numbers.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A region capability's `exp` and `ttl` are accepted only as ogygia mints them (plain digits, no leading zero) and refused as `shape` before the signature check otherwise (before, any spelling of the same expiry, such as `+n`, `0n`, `n.0` or `0x…`, verified, so one capability had many URLs).

new file .changeset/capped-request-body.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+'@ogygia/federation': patch
+---
+
+The region batch endpoint and federation's routes stop reading a request body once it passes their size cap, also when it is sent without a `content-length` (before, such a body was read whole, then refused).

new file .changeset/peer-answer-shape.md
+---
+'@ogygia/federation': patch
+---
+
+A peer answer that is JSON but not its document's shape (`{}`, a proxy's `{"error":…}`, a field of another type) is a failed hop like one that does not parse: `federation_peer_answer_invalid` is said, a static widget shows its boundary card and a page read is a 502 (before, a `TypeError` made the shell's page a 500).

new file .changeset/postrender-weak-etag.md
+---
+'@ogygia/postrender': patch
+---
+
+A stored page answers `If-None-Match` with the weak comparison RFC 9110 asks for: a `W/` etag a compressing CDN made, and `*`, now revalidate with a 304 (before, only the exact strong etag did, so such revalidations sent the whole page).

new file .changeset/profiler-busy-long-retry-after.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': patch
+---
+
+The dock's "profile this page" waits out a busy profiler's long `Retry-After` up to its two-minute deadline (before, a wait past ~24 days failed the profile with `machine_bad_time`).

new file .changeset/profiler-gzip-report-cap.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': patch
+---
+
+A report POSTed gzipped to the profiler is inflated under the same 256 MB cap as an uploaded `.ogp`, and refused past it with `devtools_profiler_upload_too_large` (413) instead of being inflated whole.

new file .changeset/profiler-login-next.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': patch
+---
+
+The profiler login's `next` is read as a URL and kept only on the app's origin and under the profiler's path, so a profiler mounted at the root (`path: ''`) no longer sends a logged-in user to another site.

new file .changeset/router-fill-dot-segments.md
+---
+'@ogygia/router': patch
+---
+
+`api()`, `href()` and `entries()` throw on a param of `.` or `..` that fills a whole path segment, instead of building a URL that names another route (`/users/[id]/delete` with `id: '..'` asked `/delete`).
